title: Costa Rica · executive (head of state)
dateText: 6 February 2022, with a runoff on 3 April 2022
system: president and vice presidents directly elected on the same ballot by modified majority popular vote (40% threshold) for a 4-year term (eligible for non-consecutive terms)
nextElection: 1 February 2026 (a runoff, if needed, will take place in April 2026)
